description.narrative: The proposed scale-up introduces several key elements designed to expand reach, deepen impact, and enhance sustainability: 1.1 Strengthening Community Structures · Train and mentor 160 CBNRM teams and DRR committee members on climate information downscaling, climate risks messaging, causes, adaptation measures climate-resilient farming methods, diversified food production, and disaster responses. · Build the capacity of 60 local leaders (12 women & 48 Men) on smallholder farmer groups and vegetable cultivation groups to take ownership of climate adaptation interventions. 1.2 Expanding Agricultural Adaptation · Distribute drought-resistant and climate-resilient seeds (sorghum, cowpeas, groundnuts) and agricultural tools to farmer groups and vulnerable households. (2250 HH) · Establish 14 vegetable nurseries and 6 tree nurseries and reforestation activities, promoting agroforestry and planting trees for erosion control. · Establish 6 tree nurseries and reforestation activities, promoting agroforestry and planting trees for erosion control · Provide 110 farmers with technical training on water-saving irrigation methods and soil conservation practices · Establish 14 vegetable smallholder farmer groups and vegetable cultivation groups to take ownership of climate adaptation interventions 1.3 Enhancing Flood Protection and Mitigation · Expand cash-for-work programmes to engage youth and women in dyke construction, reinforcement, and maintenance (12 dykes) · Promote the use of climate-resistant grasses and trees for erosion and flood control. · Train community members including local leaders in early warnings on flood prevention and preparedness, including dyke monitoring and emergency response 1.4 Strengthening Climate Knowledge and Early Warning Systems · Using prerecorded climate information downscaling messages, disseminate forecasts, predictions, and early warning messages through radio broadcasts, community meetings, and local structures reaching 12000 individuals · Establish 6 Natural Resource Management Committees (NRMCs) to support sustainable use of natural resources such as land, water, forests, and biodiversity · Establish 2 mechanisms for feedback between farmers/communities and climate service providers. · Establish 6 Agro-meteorological tools/systems to study, monitor, and forecast weather and climate conditions for supporting agriculture.
